get_state.doc: Claim-reward gate for the desk. Returns { eligible, capped, step } for the CALLER, read from yp.reward_claim: eligible=1 when the row's status is 'clicked' or 'started' — being MAILED is an invitation, not an entitlement, so the user must have followed the campaign link. This replaces the browser's localStorage latch, so the answer follows the user across devices and a re-send re-arms them. capped=1 means eligible but the campaign's limited slots (reward_conf.slots, default 100) are all taken: the desk shows the sold-out screen instead of the walkthrough, and step comes back empty because there is nothing to resume into.

track.doc: Record how far the caller got in the claim-reward flow (ui-team builtins/widget/reward-flow). One row per user in yp.reward_claim; status and step only ever advance, so a re-post can never undo a completion. Posting status='done' also REQUESTS one of the campaign's limited slots: yp.reward_claim_track awards it under a lock or writes 'missed' when the cap has closed, and `granted` carries that answer back — the only call whose result the widget must wait for.

step.description: step1 | step2 | step3 — the card step the user is on

granted.description: 1 when the caller holds a reward slot; 0 when a 'done' post was refused because the cap had closed
